title: How Does a Tow Truck Lift a Car?
description:
How Does a Tow Truck Lift a Car? I have a strong arm on my back called a boom. A long cable hangs down with a yellow hook.
A quick trucks and vehicles Short for toddlers and preschoolers ages 2–6, with Bolt the little tow truck.

title: How Does a Street Sweeper Clean the Road?
description:
How Does a Street Sweeper Clean the Road? A street sweeper has round brushes underneath that spin and spin to sweep up dirt and leaves. Some sweepers have a brush on the side too, to clean along the curb.
A quick trucks and vehicles Short for toddlers and preschoolers ages 2–6, with Bolt the little tow truck.

A street sweeper has round brushes underneath that spin and spin to sweep up dirt and leaves. Some sweepers have a brush on the side too, to clean along the curb. It sprays a little water too, so the dust does not fly up into the air. Then it scoops everything into a big box inside. A clean street for everyone!
